mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = ${@com.sky.entity.Orders@COMPLETED} THEN o.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS turnover, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = ${@com.sky.entity.Orders@COMPLETED} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS validOrderCount, IFNULL( IF(COUNT(o.id) = 0, 0, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = ${@com.sky.entity.Orders@COMPLETED} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(o.id), 2)), 0) AS orderCompletionRate, IFNULL( IF(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = ${@com.sky.entity.Orders@COMPLETED} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0, 0, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = ${@com.sky.entity.Orders@COMPLETED} THEN o.amount ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = ${@com.sky.entity.Orders@COMPLETED} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 2)), 0) AS unitPrice, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user WHERE DATE(create_time) = CURDATE()) AS newUsers FROM orders o WHERE DATE(o.order_time) = CURDATE();

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status = ${@com.sky.entity.Orders@TO_BE_CONFIRMED} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS waitingOrders, SUM(CASE WHEN status = ${@com.sky.entity.Orders@CONFIRMED} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS deliveredOrders, SUM(CASE WHEN status = ${@com.sky.entity.Orders@COMPLETED} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completedOrders, SUM(CASE WHEN status = ${@com.sky.entity.Orders@CANCELLED} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelledOrders, COUNT(*) AS allOrders FROM orders;
